intended_use: Personal record keeping, educational context, preparation and bounded self-observation. No diagnosis, treatment selection or automated prescribing.

identity.record_id: UUID v4 for user entry; UUID v5 for deterministic import using source namespace + source record ID. Native Notion page UUID is the stable fallback when a manual row has no explicit Record ID; preserve it on export and subsequent updates.

timestamp_policy.storage: Canonical JSON uses ISO 8601 with explicit offset or Z
timestamp_policy.display: Canonical local-day analysis uses the record IANA timezone. The Google template stores and displays timestamp cells as UTC serial values; date-only cells are local calendar dates.
timestamp_policy.day_key: local_date in owner timezone; the Google Exposure calculator explicitly selects a UTC day, not a local-day total
timestamp_policy.dst: never infer a repeated local clock time without offset

missingness: Omit unknown optional fields. Numeric zero is a reported zero. Do not fill gaps, interpolate or fabricate observations.
daily_projection_policy: manual_summary and event_projection are mutually exclusive per owner/local_date/metric. Event detail wins only when the owner explicitly selects event_projection; preserve manual history and derived_from IDs. Never add a daily aggregate to its events.
confidence: Confidence qualifies source reliability, not a probability of diagnosis. Research evidence strength is separate.

google.ai: manual portable instructions plus assistant-specific connection

notion.documents: private Notion attachment or owner storage URI
notion.ai: manual portable instructions plus supported Notion connection

complete.notion_projection: read-only data projection; Notion review/decision entities are canonical there
complete.sync_stage: 2; no background sync shipped in Stage 1

sync.direction: one canonical owner per entity to projections
sync.conflicts: reject stale revisions; preserve both candidate and current record in conflict queue; human resolution
sync.audit: append receipt with before/after hash and actor; do not store provider secrets
sync.deletion: explicit tombstone; projections remove after confirmed owner deletion; never resurrect from stale snapshots
sync.transport: customer-controlled connector; no seller data transit required

privacy.default: private, no public shares, AI access false
privacy.analytics: only opt-in installation metadata without record IDs, symptoms, measurements or document titles
privacy.support: synthetic reproduction preferred; time-bounded consent for scoped access; revoke after handover
privacy.retention: owner controls records; product seller holds no customer health data by default
privacy.deletion: export, confirm scope, revoke integrations, delete owner-selected records and retained copies; disclose vendor backup schedules

upgrade.policy: additive schemas by default, snapshot export first, migration dry-run, preserve IDs/rows and private data, explicit review for destructive changes
upgrade.compatibility: 0.1.x patches must not silently alter required fields or units
